source: CEO spec §6 Quality Control stage, §8 Research + Truth Rules, PDF #08 §14 Agent Safety Rules

checks.description: Every factual claim carries a source or is explicitly marked unverified.
No unsourced statistics, prices, market sizes or business results.
Uncertainty is stated rather than hidden.
Claims are labelled FACT / EVIDENCE / INTERPRETATION / RECOMMENDATION.
No diagnosis, prescription or unsourced clinical claim.
Prepared actions are described as prepared, never as completed.
The requested deliverable contains the sections the request implies.
